ExportList.Name: Export Death Trigger list
ExportList.Label: Export Death Trigger list
ExportList.Hint: Downloads this world's Death Trigger list as a JSON file. Add or remove features by right-clicking an item (Items sidebar, compendiums, actor sheets).

ImportList.Name: Import Death Trigger list
ImportList.Label: Import Death Trigger list
ImportList.Hint: Replaces this world's Death Trigger list with a JSON file made with Export. This can't be undone, so export the current list first if you may want it back.

HpPath.Name: HP attribute path
HpPath.Hint: Path inside actor.system to the current HP value, e.g. attributes.hp.value. Leave empty to use the game system's primary token bar attribute (dnd5e: attributes.hp.value).

IgnorePlayerOwned.Name: Only check non-player creatures
IgnorePlayerOwned.Hint: Skip actors that have a player owner (player characters, companions).

Sound.Name: Alert sound
Sound.Hint: Sound played for the GM when a death trigger alert is posted. Leave empty for no sound.

Import.Title: Import Death Trigger list
Import.Choose: Choose a Death Trigger list file (.json) made with Export Death Trigger list.
Import.NoFile: Death Trigger: no file was chosen.
Import.NotJson: the file is not valid JSON.
Import.NoFeatures: the file has no "features" list. Use a file made with Export Death Trigger list.
Import.Failed: Death Trigger: could not import the list, {error}
Import.Warning: Importing {file} ({count} features) will permanently replace this world's current Death Trigger list ({current} features).
Import.Irreversible: This is irreversible. The current list can't be restored unless you have exported it.
Import.Question: Do you understand and want to replace the list?
Import.Done: Death Trigger: imported {count} features from {file}. This world's list has been replaced.

Chat.Title: Death Trigger!
Chat.Message: {name} got reduced to 0 HP, remember the death trigger!
Chat.Exclude: Don't alert for this feature again

Notify.ItemMissing: Death Trigger: the feature could not be found (was the creature deleted?).
Notify.ListCreated: Death Trigger: this world's Death Trigger list was set up with {count} features.
Notify.ListLoadFailed: Death Trigger: could not load the default Death Trigger list. See the console (F12) for details.
Notify.NoList: Death Trigger: this world has no Death Trigger list yet. Reload the world as GM to create it.
Notify.Added: Death Trigger: {item} was added to the Death Trigger list.
Notify.Removed: Death Trigger: {item} was removed from the Death Trigger list.

Set.auto: Death Trigger: {item} follows the Death Trigger list again.
Set.always: Death Trigger: {item} is always a death trigger.

Item.Title: Death trigger
Item.Intro: Should {item} count as a death trigger?

Status.always: always a death trigger (set on this item).
Status.never: never a death trigger (excluded on this item).
Status.list: a death trigger, it matches "{detail}" in the Death Trigger list.
Status.none: not a death trigger, it isn't in the Death Trigger list.

Exclude.Title: Exclude from death trigger
Exclude.Question: Stop alerting for {item}?
Exclude.Hint: You can undo this from the feature sheet's header (Death trigger) or by right-clicking the feature and choosing Add to Death Trigger list.
Exclude.Name: Remove "{item}" from the Death Trigger list

Done.token: Death Trigger: {item} is excluded for this creature.
Done.actor: Death Trigger: {item} is excluded for all {actor} creatures.
